requirements.checkable: Each raffle clone escrows a single ERC-721 prize token (prizeToken, prizeTokenId) upon deposit in onERC721Received and sells entries priced at ENTRY_PRICE in quoteToken, minting one transferable ERC-721 ticket per buyEntries call.
requirements.quote: Escrows one NFT and sells fixed-price USDC entries through one transferable ERC-721 ticket per purchase.

requirements.checkable: buyEntries assigns sequential one-based ticketId values (uint256(ticketCount) + 1) and maps each ticketId in _ticketRanges to an inclusive TicketRange of uint128 firstEntry and uint128 lastEntry.
requirements.quote: Ticket IDs are sequential and map to one inclusive `[firstEntry,lastEntry]` uint128 range.

requirements.checkable: buyEntries, fulfillRandomWords, and _settleWinningTicket execute in O(1) operations without looping over entry counts.
requirements.quote: Purchases, Chainlink callbacks, and winner proofs are O(1) in entry count.

requirements.checkable: Tickets remain transferable via ERC-721 transfers until burned in redeemWinningTicket or refundTickets, where payouts go to the current ownerOf(ticketId).
requirements.quote: Tickets remain transferable bearer claims until their owners burn them for redemption or refund.

requirements.checkable: Raffle has no upgrade mechanism, no privileged admin role, and no arbitrary token, NFT, or native-currency rescue function.
requirements.quote: Each raffle is a fixed, non-upgradeable ERC-1167 clone with no administrator or rescue path.

requirements.checkable: settleWinningTicket is callable by any address and only updates storage liabilities (winnerProceeds, sponsorProceeds, protocolFees, unsettledPot, winningTicketId, settlementComplete) without transferring assets.
requirements.quote: Permissionless settlement only allocates liabilities;

requirements.checkable: redeemWinningTicket requires msg.sender == ownerOf(ticketId) and atomically burns ticketId while transferring either the prize NFT or winnerProceeds in quoteToken to the winner.
requirements.quote: the winning-ticket owner atomically burns the ticket while receiving the NFT or cash prize.

requirements.checkable: Burning a ticket in redeemWinningTicket or refundTickets does not delete _ticketRanges[ticketId], so ticketRange(ticketId) continues to return the stored (firstEntry, lastEntry) after burn.
requirements.quote: Historical ticket ranges remain stored after burns so indexers and callers can reconstruct entry coverage.

requirements.checkable: _requestInFlight is true only during the external requestRandomnessPayInNative call in requestDraw and false at all other times, causing fulfillRandomWords to ignore any synchronous callback before vrfRequestId is stored.
requirements.quote: True only while the wrapper request call is executing, so a synchronous callback cannot resolve early.

requirements.checkable: The Raffle constructor sets initialized = true and status = Status.Refunding on the implementation contract, preventing initialize or active lifecycle operations on the implementation.
requirements.quote: Deploys and locks the implementation shared by one factory's minimal-proxy raffles.

requirements.checkable: The Raffle constructor validates non-zero msg.sender, quoteToken_, and vrfWrapper_ addresses and stores factory, quoteToken, and i_vrfV2PlusWrapper in immutable variables shared by all ERC-1167 clones.
requirements.quote: Constructor state belongs to the implementation. Clones share these immutables but hold isolated storage.

requirements.checkable: receive() unconditionally reverts with DirectNativeTransfer(), and requestDraw() is the only payable entrypoint on Raffle.
requirements.quote: Rejects direct native-token transfers that are not attached to `requestDraw`.

requirements.checkable: onERC721Received reverts with UnexpectedPrize unless status == Status.AwaitingPrize, msg.sender == address(prizeToken), tokenId == prizeTokenId, from == sponsor, and operator == factory, and upon success sets status = Status.Active and returns IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector.
requirements.quote: Accepts only the exact configured prize deposited by the factory for the sponsor.

requirements.checkable: Raffle only ever transfers prizeToken with prizeTokenId in redeemWinningTicket and releaseSponsorPrize, providing no function to recover any other NFT transferred to the contract via transferFrom.
requirements.quote: Unrelated NFTs forced here with unsafe `transferFrom` remain outside protocol accounting and cannot be rescued.

requirements.checkable: onERC721Received reverts with UnexpectedPrize(msg.sender, tokenId, from, operator) if operator != factory.
requirements.quote: ERC-721 transfer operator, which must be the canonical factory.

requirements.checkable: onERC721Received reverts with UnexpectedPrize(msg.sender, tokenId, from, operator) if from != sponsor.
requirements.quote: Previous owner, which must be the configured sponsor.

requirements.checkable: onERC721Received reverts with UnexpectedPrize(msg.sender, tokenId, from, operator) if tokenId != prizeTokenId.
requirements.quote: Transferred token ID, which must match the configured prize.

requirements.checkable: name() returns the string literal "raffle.fun Ticket".
requirements.quote: Exact ERC-721 collection name, `raffle.fun Ticket`.

requirements.checkable: symbol() returns the string literal "RAFFLE".
requirements.quote: Exact ERC-721 collection symbol, `RAFFLE`.

requirements.checkable: _update does not check or restrict the raffle status when minting, transferring, or burning tickets.
requirements.quote: Tickets remain transferable bearer claims in every lifecycle state.

requirements.checkable: _update checks _isProtocolDestination(to, address(prizeToken)) for every non-zero recipient address to and reverts with UnsafeProtocolDestination(to) before calling super._update.
requirements.quote: Known protocol sinks are rejected before their ownership could make a claim unreachable.

requirements.checkable: _update bypasses _isProtocolDestination when to == address(0) so ticket burns succeed in redeemWinningTicket and refundTickets.
requirements.quote: Burns pass the zero address and remain permitted.

requirements.checkable: fulfillRandomWords computes winningEntry = uint128((randomWords[0] % uint256(totalEntries)) + 1), sets resolvedAt = uint64(block.timestamp), and sets status to Status.NftWon if totalEntries >= reserveEntries or Status.CashWon otherwise.
requirements.quote: Authenticated randomness selects only an entry.

requirements.checkable: fulfillRandomWords performs no loops, no ticket range lookups, no external calls to users or contracts, and no ERC-20 or ERC-721 transfers.
requirements.quote: No ticket search, loop, user call, or token transfer occurs.

requirements.checkable: fulfillRandomWords emits VrfCallbackIgnored(requestId, vrfRequestId, status) and returns without reverting or mutating state whenever _requestInFlight is true, status != Status.Drawing, requestId != vrfRequestId, randomWords.length != 1, or block.timestamp >= callbackDeadline().
requirements.quote: In-flight, late, wrong-request, duplicate, and ABI-decodable wrong-length callbacks are ignored for liveness;

requirements.checkable: rawFulfillRandomWords in VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase ABI-decodes (uint256, uint256[]) calldata in the external dispatcher before invoking fulfillRandomWords, reverting on malformed ABI encoding.
requirements.quote: malformed ABI calldata reverts during Solidity decoding before this handler runs.

requirements.checkable: fulfillRandomWords requires randomWords.length == 1 to resolve the raffle and ignores callbacks where randomWords.length != 1.
requirements.quote: Callback words; exactly one word is required for resolution.

requirements.checkable: _settleWinningTicket reverts if settlementComplete is true or status is neither NftWon nor CashWon, verifies _requireWinningTicket(ticketId), sets settlementComplete = true and unsettledPot = 0, and assigns winningTicketId, winnerProceeds, sponsorProceeds, and protocolFees without calling ownerOf or transferring any token.
requirements.quote: Validates the winning range once and allocates all terminal quote-token liabilities without transferring an asset or reading ticket ownership.

requirements.checkable: _settleWinningTicket computes protocolFee = Math.mulDiv(grossPot, RaffleConstants.PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS, RaffleConstants.BPS) and (for CashWon) cashAmount = Math.mulDiv(grossPot, RaffleConstants.CASH_WINNER_BPS, RaffleConstants.BPS), both rounding down via integer floor division.
requirements.quote: Both percentage allocations round down;

requirements.checkable: _settleWinningTicket sets sponsorAmount = grossPot - protocolFee for NftWon and sponsorAmount = grossPot - protocolFee - cashAmount for CashWon, assigning the exact remainder to sponsorProceeds.
requirements.quote: sponsor proceeds are the remainder.

requirements.checkable: _settleWinningTicket calls _requireWinningTicket(ticketId), which reverts with TicketDoesNotContainWinningEntry(ticketId, selectedEntry) unless firstEntry <= winningEntry <= lastEntry.
requirements.quote: Ticket whose inclusive range must contain the selected winning entry.

requirements.checkable: _settleWinningTicket returns cashAmount equal to winnerProceeds for Status.CashWon and 0 for Status.NftWon.
requirements.quote: Raw six-decimal quote-token units allocated to the cash winner, or zero for `NftWon`.

requirements.checkable: _transferQuote reverts with InvalidQuoteDestination(to) if _isProtocolDestination(to, address(prizeToken)) is true, and otherwise transfers amount of quoteToken to to via SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
requirements.quote: Transfers one complete current USDC claim through SafeERC20 after rejecting known protocol sinks.

requirements.checkable: Trust-boundary assumption that quoteToken is standard, non-rebasing, fee-free six-decimal USDC; Raffle accounts for quoteToken in nominal ENTRY_PRICE multiples without measuring balance deltas.
requirements.quote: The canonical USDC trust model assumes standard, non-rebasing, fee-free transfer semantics.

requirements.checkable: _requireStatus(expected) reverts with InvalidStatus(status) when status != expected.
requirements.quote: Reverts unless the raffle is in the expected lifecycle state.

requirements.checkable: _requireWinningTicket(ticketId) reverts with TicketDoesNotContainWinningEntry(ticketId, selectedEntry) when winningEntry < firstEntry or winningEntry > lastEntry for ticketRange(ticketId).
requirements.quote: Reverts unless the supplied ticket's stored inclusive range contains the selected winning entry.

requirements.checkable: _isProtocolDestination(destination, prizeToken_) returns true iff destination is address(this), factory, address(quoteToken), address(i_vrfV2PlusWrapper), prizeToken_, IRaffleFactory(factory).raffleImplementation(), or an address with code where IRaffleFactory(factory).isRaffle(destination) is true.
requirements.quote: Identifies same-factory protocol plumbing that cannot safely own a ticket or receive a payout.

requirements.checkable: initialize passes params.prizeToken to _isProtocolDestination before prizeToken is stored, whereas _update and _transferQuote pass address(prizeToken) from storage.
requirements.quote: Initialization supplies the prospective prize token because clone storage is not populated yet; runtime checks pass the stored prize token.

requirements.checkable: _isProtocolDestination only calls canonicalFactory.isRaffle(destination) when !unsafeDestination && destination.code.length != 0.
requirements.quote: Code-less addresses are not queried in the registry.

requirements.checkable: _validatedVrfWrapper(wrapper) reverts with ZeroAddress() if wrapper == address(0) and returns wrapper before VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase constructor initialization executes.
requirements.quote: Validates the wrapper before passing it to the inherited constructor initializer.
